description: This header file defines synchronization utilities for API locking, including thread-local flags, mutex management, function wrappers for thread-safe method invocation, and guard classes for lock management within the Utils::Synchro namespace.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Template struct managing a static recursive_mutex for each class type to ensure thread-safe API locking.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: Template guard class that unlocks the mutex upon construction if the thread is using the locked API, and re-locks it upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: Template guard class that manages locking and unlocking of the mutex via std::unique_lock.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a thread-safe wrapper around a method, managing lock acquisition and release, and setting a thread-local flag.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a method with the JSONRPC system, wrapping it with thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a method with versioning support, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a method with a JSONRPC handler, with thread safety.
